stages.text: Cycle your targeting mode (T) until it reads SHIPS.
Cycle your target ([ or ]) until you're targeting Kade Marsh, then hail him (H).

one_way_message.text: Nice, SHIPS mode. Now cycle your target with [ or ] until you're locked onto me, then hit H and let's talk.

stages.text: Talk to Kade Marsh - he's offering to show you the ropes.
Open your Mission Log (N) - it lists every objective as you go.

one_way_message.text: First thing - press N to open your Mission Log. Every step I give you shows up there, so you'll never have to guess what's next. Go ahead and take a look.

stages.text: Turn your ship - A/D or the Left/Right arrow keys.

one_way_message.text: Alright, let's start simple. Turn left with A or the left arrow, and right with D or the right arrow. Get a feel for it.

stages.text: Thrust forward - W or the Up arrow.

one_way_message.text: Good. Now hold W or the up arrow to thrust forward. Watch your speed build - space doesn't slow you down on its own.

stages.text: Turn around and brake until your speed drops - S or the Down arrow, then thrust.

one_way_message.text: Now the fun part - turning around. Hold S or the down arrow to point opposite your velocity, then thrust to cancel it out. Get your speed down.

stages.text: Fly far enough from the system center, then jump back (M to open the Star Map, J to jump).

one_way_message.text: Nicely done. Now fly far enough from the system center, open the Star Map (M), select this system, and jump (J) back home.

stages.text: Land at the station or moon (L, once you're close and slow).

one_way_message.text: You're a fast learner. Last thing - fly up to the station or moon and press L once you're close and slow to land. Good luck out there, pilot.
